comment: Kohler APM402 / Decision-Maker 3000. Register map from Kohler TP-6113 section 6. Register numbers in TP-6113 (e.g. 401100) are converted to protocol addresses by subtracting 400001 (401100 -> 0x044b). 32 bit values are read least significant word first (swapwords32), see TP-6113 section 1.3. Default controller serial settings: address 1, 19200 baud.

alert_parameter_alarm.comment: Alarms are decoded from the active alert list (TP-6113 section 6.6). Each alert is a DeviceEvent: bits 0-7 event id, bits 8-10 level (2 = warning, 3 = fault, 4 = shutdown, 5 = notice), bits 11-15 FMI, bits 16-31 parameter id. All 50 alert slots are read. This decodes event id 1 (Parameter Value Abnormal) using the level, FMI and parameter id (TP-6113 Figure 6-10).
alert_parameter_alarm.title: Alarm

alert_event_alarm.comment: Decodes the event id of warning, fault and shutdown level events (TP-6113 Figure 6-9).
alert_event_alarm.title: Alarm
